Arabic Quran font: Amiri Quran, SIL Open Font License (included).
Recitation links: Abu Bakr Al-Shatri, Yasser Al-Dosari, Nasser Al-Qatami, Abdul Rahman Al-Sudais and Mishary Al-Afasy (all 114 surahs).
MP3Quran: https://www.mp3quran.net/ar/api
Page playback: EveryAyah verse streams for Abu_Bakr_Ash-Shaatree_128kbps, Yasser_Ad-Dussary_128kbps and Nasser_Alqatami_128kbps.
Catalogue: https://everyayah.com/data/recitations.js
Only remote links are used; recordings are not redistributed or automatically downloaded.
Audio streaming availability depends on the original host and the user's connection.

Quran reading font: KFGQPC Uthmanic Script HAFS, version 0.09 (MadinahHafsClassic.ttf), distributed unmodified under the included KFGQPC-HAFS-LICENSE.txt.
Typeface reference: https://qurancomplex.gov.sa/riwaiat-hafs/ ; distributed copy: https://github.com/nuqayah/qpc-fonts/blob/master/various/UthmanicHafs1%20Ver09.otf .
Only the reading typeface changed in 1.0.79; Quran text, font-size preferences, page structure and styling are preserved. Amiri Quran remains the fallback for marked words and unsupported glyphs.

Additional full-Quran reciters in 1.0.79: Abdul Rahman Al-Sudais (https://www.mp3quran.net/ar/sds/downloads) and Mishary Al-Afasy (https://www.mp3quran.net/ar/afs/downloads), all 114 surahs. Individual ayah playback uses EveryAyah directories Abdurrahmaan_As-Sudais_192kbps and Alafasy_128kbps. Provider catalogues and both directory listings were checked on 24 October 2026. Audio is streamed on request, not bundled or automatically downloaded.

Sudais replacement recording (1.0.80), shown once as عبدالرحمن السديس: 114 complete-surah MP3 links from the published studio collection at https://archive.org/details/a0s0261002ddddddddddd . Listing and attribution: https://alkabbah.com/recitations/playlist/803492/nskh-astodyo-114-sor-kaml-mshf-alsdys-128-k-b-asdar-gdyd-aabd-alrhmn-alsdys . Official existence of a studio release: https://www.spa.gov.sa/N2563619 . The exact mirror-to-official-video match and subjective sound quality were not independently auditioned. Durations differ from the legacy set; no matching ayah timestamps were supplied. It streams complete surahs without an estimated ayah cursor. The previous Sudais verse and surah sources are no longer used; the other four readers retain individual ayah playback. Old saved files are never substituted for the studio URLs. No recording is bundled or automatically downloaded.


Mushaf line metadata (2026-11-03 trial): CC BY-SA 4.0, publisher ouryhamdalaye/madinah-mushaf-json:
https://github.com/ouryhamdalaye/madinah-mushaf-json
Pinned upstream source commit: 507eada48f3ffe26a600acf5792a18ba86d6851e
License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/
Adaptation: only word-position/heading/bismillah slots, canonical text supplied by the existing untouched Salati Tanzil source.
Validation: all 6,236 source verses and every word locator are checked against the immutable local source. The four joined word slots preserve both original words; variant bismillah forms remain exact.
Not claimed: pixel-perfect 15-line print typography on five pages (208, 586, 587, 590, 591). They remain complete/readable, but line count differs from the reference printing. All 604 pages remain locally available without photographs.


MushafBook 2026 web-sourced renderer — independent design rebuild:
Original MIT source: https://github.com/abda-dc/mushaf-companion
Ported component architecture: fixed slot/page-grid, dual ornament borders, corners, chapter header, page footer, and accessible verse interaction. The source code has been adapted for Salati and is not a claim of trademark affiliation or identical source UI.
The exact MIT license is bundled unmodified at quran/MUSHAF_BOOK_MIT_LICENSE.txt and is part of the APK assets.
All 604 line descriptors remain the independently licensed Madani map described above (CC BY-SA 4.0), and ALL actual displayed Quran words remain Salati's immutable Tanzil source text (CC BY 3.0).
No QCF V2/third-party font package or image of a full printed page has been copied.
The existing Salati licensed Quran font and its existing surah/ayah ornaments are used for this preview.
Do not claim visual identity to every line of King Fahd printed pages without verified licensed QCF glyphs and full device comparison.


Review-only Madinah QCF V2 original page-glyph renderer (2026-11-03):
The earlier unicode typesetter using KFGQPC Hafs v0.09 could display U+06DF as a huge black circle because its glyph uses a 1442-unit advance rather than the expected combining raised zero. This is a font mismatch, not a Quran word.
Corrective renderer: dist/madinah-qcf-v2.js. It selects matching QCF V2 page glyph private-use codes and individual font for the current page, only when both are successfully loaded and verified.
Exact per-page QPC V2 glyph/line data: https://github.com/manaf/KFGQPC-Madinah-Mushaf, source commit dad9cf67588ab66c914c155924d8a3699704a03d, originally from Quranic Universal Library/KFGQPC materials.
Font pages: https://verses.quran.foundation/fonts/quran/hafs/v2/woff2/ as documented at https://api-docs.quran.foundation/docs/tutorials/fonts/font-rendering/.
Official digital Mushaf software usage rights: https://dm.qurancomplex.gov.sa/rights/; underlying typesetting, fonts and page-glyph designs are copyright King Fahd Glorious Quran Printing Complex, Al-Madinah Al-Munawwarah. No claim that the fonts are under MIT/OFL.
Builder: scripts/stage-madinah-qcf-v2.py pins data commit, checks all 604 page documents and confirms exactly one legitimate ayah-end marker for all 6236 canonical original verse IDs, then packages the matching 604 WOFF2 font pages locally for offline Android use. It never rewrites the original dist/quran/data.json or the existing audio.
Fallback: if any page/font fails, the full original Quran remains available in Unicode with bundled Amiri Quran font to render U+06DF as a tiny raised zero instead of a black circular glyph. This preserves the original sign instead of deleting it.
Audio player: qTrack metadata is retained in DOM and audio code but hidden as an unreadable second line; the title 'المصحف الشريف' is displayed intact.
This preview is not authorized for official production merge or launch until the user's visual acceptance and physical-device checks.
